mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate exceeds 7.5%, it indicates labor market deterioration that signals economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE > 7.5, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 230) with elevated policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 0.10), market pricing of rate hike pauses drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and elevated policy rates
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 230 and FEDFUNDS > 0.10, or Rank IC for regime condition over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production indicates expanding manufacturing output and economic growth, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO rises, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 850 thousand units, it signals residential sector contraction that reduces consumer confidence and spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when HOUST < 850, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in employment growth and rising unemployment indicate labor market slowdown that signals economic weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises, or Rank IC for interaction term over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In weak GDP growth regimes (GDPC1 < 13700) with declining housing starts (HOUST < 850), economic slowdown triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced earnings outlook.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when GDPC1 < 13700 and HOUST < 850, or Rank IC for regime condition over 3-year rolling window remains below 0.03.
